title: A Bayesian approach to out-of-sample network reconstruction

evidence.finding: The original user explicitly retained only the BERM branch and chronological observed-update forecasts; development may choose window/variant.
The research model has one shared Erdos-Renyi edge probability and a calibrated Bayesian prior, with posterior-predictive network expectations.
The selected Beta branch uses exact posterior mean with original1e-9 probability clipping; this numeric model remains the trusted reconstruction rule.
